entities.name: António José de Ávila, 1st Duke of Ávila and Bolama
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: António José de Ávila was a Portuguese politician, minister of the kingdom, mayor of the city of Horta, on the island of Faial, in the Azores, Civil Governor of the same, Peer-of-the-Realm, Minister of State, and later Ambassador to Spain.
